title: You can learn cross-country skiing without waiting for snow
alt: Twin ski tracks running through snow between bare birch trees under a blue sky.

posts.facebook:
Cross-country skiing isn't about racing down a mountain. You glide along quiet forest trails under your own power.

And you don't have to wait for snow. In Scotland, the Huntly Nordic and Outdoor Centre, in Aberdeenshire in the north-east, teaches on an all-weather track. In the US, many Nordic (cross-country) ski centers sell a beginner package with ski rental and a trail pass.

According to the US Cross Country Ski Areas Association, a couple of hours with an instructor builds the basic skills.

Forest trails or mountain slopes: which would you choose?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-cross-country-skiing/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
